release_notes:
Version 1.0.0 - Initial Release:

- Full order management with customer tracking
- Product catalog with categories and subcategories
- Item management with set/booster support
- Finance tracking with profit/loss reports
- Pickup scheduling and management
- Email notifications via Gmail
- Google Drive backup integration
- Custom store branding with logo upload
- System tray integration with favicon
- Update check system
- Export and import data (CSV/JSON)
- Dark mode support
- Auto-start on Windows login
